tara: Quick sync 1h: external pen test confirmed Thu 09:00 PT (vendor: GreyHarbor). Scope: prod API gateway, model-hosting, artifact-store. Need RBAC snapshot, KMS ephemeral access, audit export, evidence manifest, and retest slots. Who owns what? :clipboard:
sam: Ill take RBAC snapshot + vuln triage board. Post the exact projects & service accounts and Ill export.
kevin: Ill do KMS ephemeral bindings. Confirming decrypt-only for artifacts, no signing. @anita?
anita: Decrypt-only OK. Legal requires an evidence acceptance signature and retention 90 days by default. Manifest must list signer identity and checksums. No raw prompt text in exports.
ryan: Ill own audit export and bucket immutability. Plan: pre-snapshot 20m before start, then continuous export during window. Ill set a temporary hold.
ops-bot: Temporary role request created: PT-4723456789. Approvers: @ryan, @kevin. Link: https://ops.internal/requests/4723456789 :white_check_mark:
sam: RBAC export command I plan to run:

```
rbac-export --projects=redwood-prod,redwood-staging --format=ndjson --out=rbac-4723456789.ndjson
gsutil cp rbac-4723456789.ndjson gs://pt-evidence/4723456789/
```

kevin: IAM snippet (time-bound) I will include in the PR. Example condition below; actual windows will be set just before start:

```
- role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
  members:
    - serviceAccount:pt-assessor@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  condition:
    title: "PT ephemeral"
    expression: "request.time >= timestamp('2026-09-01T16:00:00Z') && request.time <= timestamp('2026-09-01T18:00:00Z')"
```

anita: Reminder: redact any user prompts, embeddings, or PII before copying to the evidence bucket. Include a manifest.csv with sha256 checksums and a signed evidence_acceptance.txt.
ryan: Audit export quick command I'll run pretest:

```
# snapshot recent audit logs
bq query --nouse_legacy_sql "SELECT * FROM `redwood-prod.audit_logs` WHERE timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)" > audit-snap-4723456789.json
gsutil cp audit-snap-4723456789.json gs://pt-evidence/4723456789/
```

tara: Proposed retest windows: Tue-Fri next week, one 2-hour window per day. Sam, can you create the tracker with owners + severity buckets?
sam: Yep. Seeding buckets: creds/exposure, authz, data-leak, telemetry. Owners assigned. Will add regression criteria and retest checklist.
kevin: Ill also add a tiny middleware behind a feature flag to log only {request_id, route, latency_ms} for 48h during the engagement. Rollback job will remove it after window.
anita: Legal ok with that telemetry capture as long as we strip prompt text and do not log model outputs. Evidence manifest must call out redaction steps.
ryan: Operational safety: do NOT apply IAM changes earlier than 15 minutes before start to avoid stale elevated access. Ill enforce via ops-request gating.
ops-bot: Dry-run scheduled: Wed 11:00am PT. Invite posted to #eng-security.
tara: Please drop any pre-engagement notes (whitelist IPs, special service accounts, privileged endpoints) into this thread before EOD Monday. Also add oncall contacts for the retest windows.
sam: Uploading SA list and initial vuln buckets now.
kevin: PR for ephemeral role and rollback plan will be posted shortly.
anita: Ill prepare the evidence-acceptance template and upload it to the evidence bucket once ready.
tara: Great work. During the test use #release-war-room for urgent escalations and tag me. Closing loop 1: thanks all.
